derived_features.age_numeric: Integer age parsed from the SEER age label; 90 represents 90+.
derived_features.grade_unified: Grade Recode through 2017 combined with Grade Clinical from 2018 onward.
derived_features.tumor_size_mm: Numeric millimeters for codes 000 through 400; special codes are missing.
derived_features.tumor_size_status: Measured, no evidence of primary tumor, microscopic focus, site-specific, unknown or unreasonable, or inconsistent/not applicable.

forbidden_model_inputs.Patient ID: Identifier used only for privacy-safe cohort and split validation.
forbidden_model_inputs.Sequence number: Administrative tumor order used only for deterministic index-record selection.
forbidden_model_inputs.Year of diagnosis: Used for temporal splitting and excluded to reduce temporal shortcut learning.
forbidden_model_inputs.Regional nodes positive (1988+): Direct source of the prediction target.
forbidden_model_inputs.Regional nodes examined (1988+): Closely tied to how the target was measured and could leak procedural information.
forbidden_model_inputs.Diagnostic Confirmation: Administrative confirmation field and nearly constant in this cohort.
forbidden_model_inputs.source_row_number: Internal reproducibility field with no clinical meaning.
forbidden_model_inputs.sequence_rank: Internal index-selection field with no model role.
forbidden_model_inputs.year_numeric: Used only for temporal splitting and auditing.
forbidden_model_inputs.node_positive_target: Prediction target and never an input.
forbidden_model_inputs.split: Dataset partition metadata and never an input.
